question: Should OpenClaw accept FreeBSD as an official supported platform, and if so at what support tier?
rationale: The request spans release ownership, FreeBSD ports/pkg publication, installer/update behavior, service management, CI capacity, and support policy; current code has no FreeBSD platform path that can be safely completed as one narrow fix.

options.title: Keep As Product Planning
options.body: Keep this issue open for a maintainer platform-support decision before implementation is split into release/package work.

options.title: Decline Official Support For Now
options.body: Close after a maintainer decides FreeBSD is outside current supported platforms and documents any community-supported path.

options.title: Sponsor Experimental FreeBSD
options.body: Accept a lower-tier experimental path with explicit owner, docs, and validation boundaries before advertising support.

recommendation.title: Keep As Product Planning
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open for a maintainer platform-support decision before implementation is split into release/package work.

likelyOwner.reason: This is a platform-tier and release-ownership decision, and CONTRIBUTING.md lists steipete as the project lead.
